sources.entry: How to start an AppSec program with the OWASP Top 10

summary.title: How to start an AppSec Program with the OWASP Top 10
summary.one_liner: Learn a staged approach to building an application security program, using the OWASP Top 10 as a baseline while adding SAMM, paved road development practices, and ASVS.
takeaways: The OWASP Top 10 is a useful starting baseline for checklists but is not sufficient alone as an AppSec program.
Use OWASP SAMM over a 1-3 year period to assess current gaps and prioritize security practices.
A paved road is a set of secure, drop-in library and tooling defaults that make the secure option the easiest option, built with development teams.
Add CI checks that warn or reject insecure alternatives once a paved road component is adopted, to prevent technical debt.
Mature programs go beyond the Top 10 by adopting ASVS levels, threat modeling, automation, and continuous improvement.
summary.summary: This article gives a six-stage guide to starting an application security program around the OWASP Top 10 2021. It recommends first assessing gaps and goals with OWASP SAMM, then planning and building a "paved road" secure development lifecycle together with development teams. The later stages cover migrating applications to the paved road with CI checks, testing that components mitigate Top 10 issues, and growing toward a mature program using ASVS levels. It closes with principles for going further: security architecture, automation, a shared culture between AppSec and dev teams, and continuous improvement.
